summary: First-finish latency smoke test for MoodReel. Backend: all 7 endpoints (health, context, recommend x3, movie, vibe POST+GET) return 200 with expected fields and mock catalog fallback works. LLM blurbs are present on picks (Claude Haiku 4.5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). Frontend: landing renders logo, hero, context badge, 8 mood chips, vibe input, obscure dial, nostalgia toggle. Movie grid populates with 8 cards. Mood chip click, refresh, share (URL with ?v= copied to clipboard), Surprise Me overlay + Reroll, movie modal + close, dial change (labels shift to Buried Treasure) and nostalgia toggle activation all work. Zero console errors.
passed: GET /api/context -> 200 with weather.available=false, time_of_day, trending_titles, now
POST /api/recommend {mood:cozy,dial:5} -> 200, 8 picks, source=mock, each pick has id/title/year/rating/poster/blurb
POST /api/recommend {mood:nostalgic,dial:8,nostalgia:true} -> 8 picks skewed to 80s-90s and lower vote counts (Whisper of the Heart 1995, Kiki 1989, Stand by Me 1986)
POST /api/recommend {vibe_text:'a rainy Sunday alone',dial:6} -> 8 relevant picks
POST /api/vibe + GET /api/vibe/{id} -> 200 round-trip with mood/vibe_text/dial/nostalgia payload preserved
Frontend: 8 mood chips visible with correct data-testid ids
Frontend: vibe-input, obscure-dial, nostalgia-toggle all visible/functional
Frontend: movie grid renders 8 cards with LLM blurbs (e.g., Perfect Blue blurb visible)
Frontend: movie-modal opens with content and modal-close-button closes it
Frontend: surprise-overlay opens; Reroll updates the shown movie
Frontend: Share copies URL containing ?v=<id>&dial=5 to clipboard; toast element rendered
Frontend: obscure dial adjustment triggers /recommend (debounced); title/label updates to 'Buried Treasure'
Frontend: nostalgia toggle activates (hero copy shifts to 'Rewind to warmer light', re-fetch triggered)
Frontend: 0 console errors during full flow

failed.issue: Sepia filter not detected on elements when Nostalgia Mode is toggled ON. Sepia may be applied via wrapper element/CSS variable rather than the img filter, or the check ran during a skeleton reload. Toggle itself activates visually and content changes correctly.
failed.evidence: page.evaluate scan of all computed styles found no filter containing 'sepia'; no elements with class matching 'sepia'. UI clearly shows nostalgia mode ON in screenshot.

failed.issue: Pressing Escape does not close the Surprise Me overlay. Users may not have an obvious way to dismiss it besides Reroll (no close (x) button observed inside overlay).
failed.evidence: After overlay opened, page.keyboard.press('Escape') did not dismiss it; subsequent click on Refresh button was intercepted by the surprise-overlay div.

action_items: Optional: Confirm the sepia effect implementation — apply CSS filter directly on poster (or a testable wrapper class like 'sepia') so it is visually obvious and easily verified.
Add an Escape-to-close handler and/or a visible close (x) button to the Surprise Me overlay (data-testid='surprise-overlay') for better UX.
